items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: In later years, you've heard of the other girl bands, Ina Rae Hutton -- various -- female musicians make a great, great group.

ctx.x: What was your impression of them, and what was the general impression of the Sweethearts of Rhythm at that time? Did people look at them as a novelty orchestra? You know, what are these gals up here trying to prove or were they taken seriously as musicians because they were accomplished musicians?

Oh, yes, those girls could really wail, the could wail just like the male band. They had a great band with rhythm. In later years, you've heard of the other girl bands, Ina Rae Hutton -- various -- female musicians make a great, great group.

Okay, how about -- I think actually before you went to New York you mentioned that you had gone to Texas. You played in Dallas. Just exactly when does that come along? Does that precede your going with Harlan Leonard -- could you tell us a little bit about that?
